about: Hanging glow tendrils, 1.6 m: seven green threads with bead motes, for the undersides of bridges, balconies and arches. Origin at the attachment point; hangs down (-Z).

acoustics.about: materials carry glTF extras {"acoustic": <preset|"none">}; large near-level meshes carry node extras {"acoustic": <preset>} (what the game reads); relief, trim, clutter and plants are left out

lights.City_GlowGreen: green core, emissive at peak; the game breathes with the audio clock
lights.City_GlowGreenHalo: green halo shell (alpha 0.25), at peak with its core
